text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle is hard at work training for the Mile Championship.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, she learns that her friend, Silence Suzuka, will be entering the same race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suzuka explains that she's on a search to find the "something" that she's missing by challenging herself with various races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the knowledge that she'll be running against her rival, Taiki Shuttle's excitement is through the roof. She gives our training sessions her undivided attention.
